inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Operon diagram (promoter, operator, CAP site, lacZ/lacY/lacA) plus four states: +glucose +lactose (low), +glucose -lactose (off), -glucose +lactose (max, CAP-cAMP on, repressor off), -glucose -lactose (off)

notes: Original KYP redraw preserves the operon anatomy strip (lacI, CAP site, promoter, operator, lacZ/Y/A), both regulatory cascades (glucose⊣adenylate cyclase; allolactose⊣repressor), and the source's four-state truth table with expression outcomes.
